test: edge-refined coarse level, gci_C interval counts with gci_M edge spacings
cells_note: identical to gci_C, so only the edge spacing differs
hypothesis: the constant -0.00273 CDp offset is leading/trailing edge resolution
verdict: REFUTED - edge refinement recovers about 7 per cent of the offset
consequence: global near-body refinement is genuinely required; there is no cheap redistribution that buys gci_M drag at gci_C cost
supporting: CDv is converged to 1.4 per cent while CDp is not, so the boundary layer is resolved for skin friction but the pressure field is not resolved for form drag
